items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So Hilton Jefferson, God bless him, he said, 'Buddy, I can't lie.' He says, 'I was in the band and I was one of them.'

ctx.x: The fact that Fletcher chose him didn't carry any weight.
Didn't carry any weight. So Hilton Jefferson, God bless him, he said, "Buddy, I can't lie." He

says, "I was in the band and I was one of them." He says, "I treated him terrible, too." And he said, "Some of the notes would look like it would be G natural because Hawk wasted whiskey on him," he said, "he knew all the arrangements," and he didn't have to read them, you know, and he'd waste whiskey on him and the boy would think it was a G and it would be a B or something. So then he says, "He just had a hard time in here," said, "we really treated him cool."
